title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Depot
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Depot. Site where waste collection vehicles are parked when not in use. Subclass of geo:Feature, org:Site and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.2); org:Site is out of this candidate's scope and carries no properties translated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Depot'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the depot, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.
